from collections import deque
names = ['G1','G2','G3','G4','R1','R2','R4']

}
def key(d): return tuple(d[k] for k in names)
start = key(cur)
prev = {start: None}; q = deque([start])
while q:
    st = q.popleft()
    for i in range(7):
        for j in range(i+1, 7):
            lst = list(st); lst[i], lst[j] = lst[j], lst[i]; ns = tuple(lst)
            if ns not in prev:
                prev[ns] = (st, (names[i], names[j])); q.append(ns)
best = None
for name, tgt in cands.items():
    g = key(tgt); st = g; path = []
    while prev[st] is not None:
        st, mv = prev[st]; path.append(mv)
    path.reverse()
    print(name, 'dist', len(path), path)
    if best is None or len(path) < best[1]: best = (name, len(path), path)
name, dist, path = best
print('CHOSE', name)
# execute programmatically

            slots[('R' if r0 < 30 else 'G') + str((c0-18)//6+1)] = n['color']
    return slots
